answer: Locks are logged in umber, expire in comet, and vertex lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 70 aliases therefore needs 122 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4816 identities would post 4845 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
